description: A microSD card reader/writer with an SPI interface.
how_to_use: Shares its SCK/DO/DI lines with any other SPI device on the same bus; give it its own, unique CS pin.

plain.what: A memory card reader, so your project can save data or read files.
plain.how: VCC, GND and four data wires (MISO, MOSI, SCK, CS) to the Arduino. The SD library reads and writes files.
